email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with occasional dizziness

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 64-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their fourth dose of DemoZanix (dose: 25mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-07-03.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
T. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
